name: openscad-preview
description: Render OpenSCAD files to PNG previews for visual CAD inspection from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Render .scad files to PNG previews with bundled OpenSCAD CLI wrappers, feature-detected default arguments, configurable camera views, and multi-angle preview generation.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenSCAD Preview to render this .scad file and inspect the generated PNG.
Use OpenSCAD Preview to generate multi-angle previews for this OpenSCAD assembly.
Use OpenSCAD Preview to rerender this part after the geometry change.
